name: Agent-First Mail
synopsis: Let your AI agent work your inbox the way it works a git checkout — mail pulled into local files it reads, sorts, and drafts on your machine, and nothing reaches your real mailbox until you confirm the push.
intent: Give AI agents a local-first email workspace where pulled messages become editable case files rather than a traditional inbox app

Preserve raw RFC822 mail while exposing mechanically cleaned text, message metadata, active cases, archived cases, contacts, notification collections, send identities, drafts, notes, and files through stable filesystem conventions, with human-readable Markdown rendered in the workspace language

Keep the CLI focused on source inspection, read-only IMAP pulls, acknowledged Cloudflare R2 imports and Worker scaffolding, explicit local triage/case/notification/contact organization, Chrome-based human review sessions for typed decisions and hash-checked local notes/draft editing, attachment fetches, reply draft scaffolding and validation, local push queuing, confirmed remote push effects, audit log inspection, and push queue visibility

Expose the same domain core to trusted Agent runtimes and applications through a bearer-protected OpenAPI 3.2 HTTP API with standalone JSON Schemas, persistent idempotency, transaction guards, and unchanged push plan confirmation
mutations: Receive mail through Cloudflare Email Routing and R2, and send through Cloudflare's API.
Exchange native JSON messages through file channels.
Wake an agent only when mail arrives with afmail cloudflare watch.
Let a person settle an uncertain send with push recover --sent or --not-sent.
Pull and purge large workspaces in seconds instead of minutes.
Upgrade v0.12.0 workspaces once with afmail init.

bonds.reason: All structured output, field suffixes, secret handling, and JSONL events follow Agent-First Data conventions
Path/URL slug generation and path-segment validation use Agent-First Slug
